arrest: You are under arrest for {crime} as you were caught in the act.

crimes.obstruction: obstructing a public official in the performance of duty

rights: You have the right to appoint a lawyer and receive assistance from your lawyer.
You have the right to explain yourself.
You have the right to remain silent.
And you have the right to request a court review of your arrest.
voluntary: I am asking you to come with me to the police station for questioning.
This is not mandatory. You have the right to refuse.
Even if you come with us, you may leave the police station at any time.
You may contact your family or friends, and you may receive assistance from a lawyer.
Will you come with us voluntarily? Please answer yes or no.
consular: As a foreign national, you have the right to request that the consulate of your country be notified of your arrest.
You may also communicate with consular officers and receive visits from them.
Do you want us to notify your consulate? Please answer yes or no.
